## Result

**Binary: alcanzai-core/src/bin/alcanzai.rs**
- clap 4 derive-macro CLI
- alcanzai vault regenerate --library <PATH> --vault <PATH> [--note-subdir <PATH>] → VaultProjection::rebuild
- alcanzai vault render --library <PATH> --vault <PATH> [--note-subdir <PATH>] → VaultProjection::render
- cargo run --bin alcanzai -- vault regenerate --help exits 0 ✓

**Integration tests: alcanzai-core/tests/vault_rebuild_integration.rs**
Three tests, no external services (open_in_memory + tempfile::TempDir):

1. delete_and_rebuild_produces_identical_vault — §6 test #5: seeds 3 KOs (academic_pdf with blocks+abstract, web_article, unknown/bare), rebuilds vault, deletes entire vault root (rm -rf equivalent), rebuilds again → assert_eq!(first, second). PASSES.

2. render_after_rebuild_is_noop — incremental render after full rebuild changes nothing (watermark > all updated_at). PASSES.

3. academic_pdf_note_contains_expected_content — verifies known content in the arXiv paper note (title heading, author, year, Abstract section, Content section, heading block). PASSES.

cargo fmt ✓ cargo clippy -D warnings ✓ (zero warnings) cargo test ✓

Total: 36 tests (22 unit + 11 membrane + 3 integration).

§6 test #5 DISCHARGED: vault deletion + rebuild = empty diff.
M1 done-condition: vault can be deleted and fully regenerated from the Library with zero LLM calls. ✓

#20 (seed KOs + M1 integration + mutant count) is now unblocked.
